name: Fallen Authority
source: You wake in a medical room with no memory, your body already changed and labeled as if it was never yours. A chip in your brain watches every thought, cutting off resistance before it can form. When you try to think for yourself, something tightens inside your head and forces it to stop. Chemicals are pumped into you without pause, dulling your will and reshaping you until even your body stops resisting. Will you keep fighting for control, or let them finish taking it from you?
